xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
1. The above results have been reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on October 29, 2026 and have been subjected to limited review by the statutory auditors of the Company.
2. The Board of Directors of the Company have recommended interim dividend of Rs. 10/- per share.
3. The accompanying financial results have been prepared as per the format prescribed under Regulation 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 as modified by Circular No. CIR/CFD/FAC/62/2016 dated July 5, 2016.
4. The financial results have been prepared in accordance with Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) notified under the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015 (as amended from time to time) read with section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013.
5. The Company entered into definitive agreements with State Bank of India and NSE IFSC Limited on 19 October 2026 for the sale of a 9.90% equity stake each in its wholly owned subsidiary, CareEdge Global IFSC Limited (CGIL). Upon completion of the transaction, the Company's shareholding in CGIL will be reduced to 80.20%, and CGIL will cease to be a wholly owned subsidiary upon completion of the closing actions and approval of the share transfer by the Board of CGIL.
6. The Company’s business activity falls within a single primary operating segment viz. ‘Ratings and other related services’. The operating segment has been defined based on regular review by the Company’s Chief Operating Decision Maker to assess the performance of the Company and to make decisions about allocation of resources.
7. The Company has alloted 57,999 equity shares of Rs.10 each pursuant to excercise of employee stock options during Q2 FY 26-27. As per Ind AS 102 - Share Based Payment, total cost of ESOS 2020 is recognised over vesting period.
8. Employee Benefit Expenses in Standalone results includes ESOP charge for Q2FY27 is Rs. 58.83 lakhs and H1FY27 is Rs. 102.68 lakhs.
